title: Disjointness of Hamming spheres of distinct radii
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a finite alphabet, fix a centre word $u \in \alpha^n$, and let $r$ and $t$ be natural numbers with $r \ne t$. Then the Hamming sphere $S_r(u) = \{v \in \alpha^n : d(u,v) = r\}$ of radius $r$ and the Hamming sphere $S_t(u) = \{v \in \alpha^n : d(u,v) = t\}$ of radius $t$, both centred at $u$, are disjoint, where $d$ denotes the Hamming distance.
replaced:
For any centre $u$ and distinct radii $r \ne t$, the Hamming spheres
$S_r(u)$ and $S_t(u)$ are disjoint finsets.
